entries.question: Which ONE change brings the most additional revenue?
entries.method: Code-level (SignupPage, PricingPage). Live conversion RATES need GA4/CRM (not connected) — see connectors-setup.md.
observations: Signup form: first name, last name, company, email, password + AGB + AVV checkboxes — moderately heavy; every required field costs completion.
No social login (Google OAuth) on signup — a major friction lever for trial conversion.
Pricing: 129€ Starter + mid + Enterprise (demo). CTA '7 Tage kostenlos testen'.
TRIAL-LENGTH INCONSISTENCY: README/landing reference a 14-day trial; pricing CTA says '7 Tage' — mismatched promise hurts trust/conversion.

goalCandidates.title: Add Google sign-up (OAuth) to cut signup friction
goalCandidates.note: AUTH change → HIGH risk, approval-required, analysis-only

goalCandidates.title: Reduce required signup fields (defer last-name/company to post-signup)

goalCandidates.revenueImpact: MEDIUM — trust/clarity; needs product decision on the correct value

goalCandidates.revenueImpact: HIGH — but NEVER auto-change pricing; approval-required
